```{r}
# Posterior contrasts (part = "contrasts") or sampling-period predicted
# probabilities (part = "periods") from the full model, for substrate use
# (Supplementary Tables 2 and 3) or behavioral responses (Supplementary
# Tables 6 and 5). Reads the cached marginaleffects outputs saved
# by stats_v02.qmd. Rendered by scripts/render_supplementary_tables.R

library(knitr)
options(kableExtra.latex.load_packages = FALSE)
library(kableExtra)

root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_rstudio_project)
proc <- file.path(root, "data/processed")

analysis <- params$analysis

if (analysis == "behavior") {
  # the ggbeh*.RDS caches are lists with $plot and $data
  contr <- list(
    "Food substrate" = readRDS(file.path(proc, "ggbeh1.RDS"))$data,
    "Number of legs" = readRDS(file.path(proc, "ggbeh4.RDS"))$data,
    "Sensory leg condition" = readRDS(file.path(proc, "ggbeh5.RDS"))$data
  )
  preds <- as.data.frame(readRDS(file.path(proc, "ggbeh2.RDS"))$data)
  response_labels <- c(
    Bobbing = "Bobbing", Chemicalrelease = "Chemical release",
    Escape = "Escape", Flee = "Flee", Freeze = "Freeze"
  )
  response_title <- "Behavior"
} else {
  # the *_contrast.rds caches store the contrast data inside the ggplot
  contr <- list(
    "Food substrate" = readRDS(file.path(proc, "food_substrate_contrast.rds"))$plot$data,
    "Experimental phase" = readRDS(file.path(proc, "phase_contrast.rds"))$plot$data,
    "Number of legs" = readRDS(file.path(proc, "number_of_legs_contrast.rds"))$plot$data,
    "Sensory leg condition" = readRDS(file.path(proc, "sensory_leg_missing_contrast.rds"))$plot$data
  )
  preds <- as.data.frame(readRDS(file.path(proc, "ggsub1.RDS"))$data)
  response_labels <- c(other_substrate = "Other substrate", rock = "Rock", sand = "Sand")
  response_title <- "Substrate"
}

contrast_labels <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("Sensory_missing - Both_sensory_present",
            "sensory leg(s) missing $-$ both present", x)
  x <- gsub("training - acclimation", "training $-$ acclimation", x)
  x <- gsub("sand - rock", "sand $-$ rock", x)
  x <- gsub("^([0-9]) - ([0-9])$", "\\1 legs $-$ \\2 legs", x)
  x
}

fmt_ci <- function(est, lo, hi) {
  # avoid printing tiny negative values as "-0.000"
  gsub("-0\\.000", "0.000", sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", est, lo, hi))
}

ctab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(contr), function(p) {
  d <- as.data.frame(contr[[p]])
  d <- d[order(d$group, d$contrast), ]
  data.frame(
    predictor = p,
    contrast = contrast_labels(d$contrast),
    response = unname(response_labels[as.character(d$group)]),
    estimate = fmt_ci(d$estimate, d$conf.low, d$conf.high),
    excl = ifelse(d$conf.low > 0 | d$conf.high < 0, "*", "")
  )
}))

# predicted probabilities: one row per sampling period, one column per response
preds$cell <- fmt_ci(preds$estimate, preds$conf.low, preds$conf.high)
ptab <- reshape(
  preds[, c("sampling_period", "group", "cell")],
  idvar = "sampling_period", timevar = "group", direction = "wide"
)
names(ptab) <- c("Sampling period", unname(response_labels[sub("^cell\\.", "", names(ptab)[-1])]))
ptab <- ptab[order(as.numeric(as.character(ptab$`Sampling period`))), ]

what <- switch(
  analysis,
  behavior = "the probability of each behavioral response to the aversive stimulus",
  substrate = "the probability of using each substrate"
)
model_desc <- switch(
  analysis,
  behavior = "full multivariate Bernoulli mixed model of behavioral responses",
  substrate = "full additive categorical mixed model of substrate use"
)
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr params$part == "contrasts"
ctab_out <- ctab[, c("contrast", "response", "estimate", "excl")]

kbl(
  ctab_out,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  longtable = TRUE,
  linesep = "",
  escape = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  align = c("l", "l", "r", "l"),
  col.names = c("Contrast", response_title, "Estimate [95\\% CrI]", ""),
  caption = paste0(
    "\\textbf{Supplementary Table ", params$table_no, ".} ",
    "Posterior average contrasts in ", what,
    " from the ", model_desc,
    ", averaged over the observed values of all other predictors."
  )
) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "repeat_header"), font_size = 9) |>
  pack_rows(index = table(factor(ctab$predictor, levels = unique(ctab$predictor)))) |>
  footnote(
    general = paste0(
      "Estimates are posterior means of the difference in predicted probability ",
      "(e.g., 0.10 = 10 percentage points) with 95\\\\% credible intervals (CrI). ",
      "* 95\\\\% CrI excludes zero. Food substrate refers to the substrate on which food ",
      "(rewarding stimulus) was presented."
    ),
    threeparttable = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,
    general_title = "Note."
  )
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr params$part == "periods"
kbl(
  ptab,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  longtable = TRUE,
  linesep = "",
  escape = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  align = c("c", rep("r", ncol(ptab) - 1)),
  caption = paste0(
    "\\textbf{Supplementary Table ", params$table_no, ".} ",
    "Posterior predicted probabilities [95\\% CrI] of ",
    sub("^the probability of ", "", what),
    " across sampling periods (modeled as a monotonic effect) from the ", model_desc,
    ", averaged over the observed values of all other predictors."
  )
) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "repeat_header"), font_size = 9)
```
